# Entity (TypeDef) format

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

**Source table:** `MET_TYPEDEF` · **Confidence:** Verified

An entity in Barsa is a `TypeDef` row. `DbName` is the physical table that holds its instance rows, which is how `dyn_*` and `m0*_` tables connect back to the metamodel.

| Column | XSD type | Nullable in schema | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|
| `caption` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `DbName` | string | yes | Physical table name for instances. |
| `DefaultFieldId` | long | yes | FieldDef used as the default. |
| `systemId` | long | yes | Owning MET_METASYSTEM row. |
| `previewFieldId` | long | yes | FieldDef used for preview text. |
| `hasSecurity` | boolean | yes |  |
| `isExternalType` | boolean | yes |  |
| `Settings` | base64Binary | yes | Opaque settings payload — contents Unknown. |
| `ID` | long | yes | Primary key, Barsa composite id. |
| `deleted_eorgIdTypePart` | long | yes |  |
| `iconName` | string | yes |  |
| `iconImage` | base64Binary | yes |  |
| `defaultReportId` | long | yes | met_Report shown by default. |
| `dbType` | long | yes |  |
| `CreationDate` | dateTime | yes |  |
| `IsDeleted` | boolean | yes | Soft-delete flag. |
| `LocalId` | long | yes | Scope-local id; see $spl_EorgType. |
| `parentid` | long | yes | Inheritance parent TypeDef. |
| `isDynamic` | boolean | yes | Whether instances live in a dyn_* table. |
| `sakooTypeId` | long | yes |  |
| `ApplicationId` | long | yes |  |

Column meanings left blank are **Unknown**: the column name alone is not
evidence of its semantics.
